verses.4:53: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ نَصِيبࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ فَإِذࣰ ا لَّا يُؤۡتُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ نَقِيرًا
verses.4:124: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ نَقِيرࣰ ا

meaning: The root نَقَرَ (naqara) primarily means to peck, like a bird, or to strike with a pointed object. It extends to striking a musical instrument, making a sound to urge an animal, or boring/perforating.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
